added_lines: . HEALTHY AND SMART CHILDREN FOUNDATION Dr Christian will be making an appeal for his charity at the weekend Masses in Portrush next weekend, Sun 29 Nov. ST COLUM’S PRIMARY SCHOOL PTA CHRISTMAS COFFEE MORNING - SUN 29 NOV. In St. Mary’s, Star of the Sea Parish Centre, Portstewart, from 11.00am - 12.30pm. Come along for a morning of family festive fun. Everyone welcome. Annual Mass for Deceased Diocesan Clergy & Religious The Annual Mass for Deceased Diocesan Clergy and Religious will take place on Tuesday 24th of November 2026 in St Peter's Cathedral, Belfast at 7:30pm. In particular we remember and offer Mass for those who have died in this past year. All are welcome to join Bishop Alan McGuckian SJ as he celebrates this Mass. OLIVE BRANCH COFFEE MORNING and Craft Sale in the St. Mary’s, Star of the Sea Parish Centre, Portstewart on Sunday 22nd November from 10am-1pm. All proceeds will go to the Olive Branch who provide free mental health counselling in our local area. £4 admission. FESTIVAL OF NINE LESSONS & CAROLS Causeway Churches Forum and Counterpoint Choir warmly invite you to join them in "A Festival of Nine Lessons and Carols " be held in St. Malachy's Church Coleraine on Sunday 6th December at 7.30 pm. Refreshments afterwards beside the Church in St. Malachy's Pastoral Centre. Hoping to see you there. PORTSTEWART MEN’S SHED Portstewart Men's Shed (at 24 Central Avenue) will be open on the morning of Sat. 28th November from 10.30am-1.00pm. This coincides with the Christmas Market in the Presbyterian Church Hall next door. This will enable visitors to see the facilities available for the recently relaunched activities and to encourage further use and engagement for the whole community. There will be a selection of bicycles, many of them children's bicycles, that have been donated for refurbishment/repair as part of the Shed's Recycle programme; these bicycles will be available at reasonable cost to young families (essentially a donation to cover the expense of repairs) with an understanding they’renot, in the short-term, for resale outside of the recipient family. 'SVP GIVING SUNDAY - 06 DECEMBER The annual Society of St. Vincent de Paul (SVP) Christmas collection will take place after both Masses in St. Malachy's Church, Coleraine on Sun 6th December. Our thanks to everyone for their donations throughout the year. All donations will be warmly welcomed. THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT AND GENEROSITY! Portstewart
